note: Phase 19, kg policy: the three surfaces lisp/help-fns.el is built on. A definition registers its name whether or not it has a docstring; a public prelude definition answers `documentation'; an `internal--' one deliberately does not; a BUILT-IN command is enumerable and its one-line cmdtable summary is its documentation. Not oracle-compared: Emacs' `documentation' returns its own texts, and the command table is kg's.
